problem: The company wanted to concentrate on Cloud and Data Center offerings.
title: Atlassian stops selling Server products and pushes customers to Cloud and Data Center
context: Atlassian sold self-hosted Server versions of Jira, Confluence and other products.
decision_made: End new Server sales on 2 February 2021, raise maintenance prices, and end support in February 2024.
action_taken: Offered migration tools and trials for Cloud, and recommended Data Center for stricter requirements.
observed_outcome: Server went off sale in February 2021 and, per Atlassian's page, support ended on 15 February 2024.
lessons: A vendor can force migration through end-of-sale dates and price increases, with customer pushback as a cost.
limitations: Customer satisfaction, churn and revenue effects were not found. Sources differ slightly on dates.

claims.claim_text: Atlassian said it would stop selling new Server licences and cease Server feature development on 2 February 2021.
Atlassian's page states Server products are no longer supported as of 15 February 2024.
